{{Elections in Nebraska}}
The '''2026 Nebraska gubernatorial election''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[governor of Nebraska]]. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] governor [[Jim Pillen]] is running for re-election to a second term. 

[[Primary elections]] took place on May 12, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|date=May 9, 2025|title=2026 State Primary Election Dates|url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260509222424/https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|archive-date=May 9, 2026|website=way[[National Conference of State Legislatures]]|access-date=August 5, 2025}}</ref> Pillen secured his party's nomination with 76% of the vote, while [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] former state senator [[Lynne Walz]] secured her party's nomination with 91% of the vote. Democrats have not won a gubernatorial election in Nebraska since [[1994 Nebraska gubernatorial election|1994]].
